newsitem.title: UK: Iraq confirms to Euro crude buyers 25 cent price cut.
newsitem.headline: Iraq confirms to Euro crude buyers 25 cent price cut.

text.p: Iraq's State Oil Marketing Organisation (SOMO) has confirmed to European buyers a 25 cent reduction in the formula for its Kirkuk crude, oil traders said on Monday.
Kirkuk would be priced at Dated Brent less $1.80 fob Ceyhan from March 10 when the second 90-day period of the United Nations six-month oil-for-food exchange began, the traders said.
Kirkuk for April would be priced at Dated Brent less $1.90 fob, reflecting a 10 cent reduction in the price of competitor crude Saudi Arab Light for the month.
Iraqi crude formulas are priced against regional benchmark crudes for Asia, Europe and the U.S. and moved in line with changes to Arab Light to each region.
